objective: Je veux pouvoir exporter mes tâches.
refinements: Je veux du CSV sur la sortie standard et je veux garder l'affichage actuel par défaut.
last_diff:
--- a/src/tasks.nim
+++ b/src/tasks.nim
+proc csvFieldNeedsQuote*(s: string): bool =
+  for c in s:
+    if c in {',', '"', '\n', '\r'}:
+      return true
+  false
+proc csvQuote*(s: string): string =
+  if not csvFieldNeedsQuote(s):
+    return s
+  result = "\""
+  for c in s:
+    if c == '"': result.add("\"\"")
+    else: result.add(c)
+  result.add('"')
+proc formatCsv*(tasks: openArray[Task]): string =
+  var lines: seq[string] = @["id,title"]
+  for t in tasks:
+    lines.add($t.id & "," & csvQuote(t.title))
+  lines.join("\n")
